Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
Can I tap Heidelberg before a minion makes his mandatory action ?

Like, if he suddenly lost blood and was untapped, could I tap it before he
hunted ?

Of if Philippe Rigaud had to diablerize, could I instead empty him of his
blood so he'd have to hunt right away ?

--
"All Hail the Lords of the Night !"

Orpheus

Messages.Author: Wookie813
Messages.Body:


Card Text:

Unique location.

Tap to transfer equipment cards, move blood and transfer retainers
between any two ready vampires you control. (You may choose the amount
of blood you move and which cards you transfer.) Cannot be used during
an action.

Clarifications and Rulings

May not be tapped "during" paying some cost - must be tapped before or
after. [SFC 19960830]

Heidelburg Castle may not be tapped "in response" to any instant
effect (because all effects in V:TES are instantaneous except for
actions and certain combat effects). [LSJ]

I would say "yes" to both of your queries. What you describe is, in
my opinion, effective use of HC and a good reason to include it in a
deck. You just can't tap it *during* an action, say to add blood to
Phillipe so he can pay for an Earth Meld after a block attempt is
declared.
